PROMOTION APPROVED BY HIS EXCELLENCY THE PRESIDENT

BY virtue of the authority vested in me as President and as Commander –in – Chief of the Armed Forces of the DemocraticSocialist Republic of Sri Lanka. I have awarded the honorary rank of Admiral of the Fleet to Admiral Wasantha KumarJayadewa Karannagoda (Rtd.), RSP VSV USP PhD MBA MSc ndc psc DISS Commander of the Sri Lanka Navy (2005 –2009) for outstanding gallantry, meritorious performance and distinguished service to the nation during the humanitarianoperation and the defeat of terrorism in Sri Lanka given under my hand on 05th day of August 2019.
MAITHRIPALA SIRISENA,President of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka.05th August, 2019
PROMOTION APPROVED BY HIS EXCELLENCY THE PRESIDENT

BY virtue of the authority vested in me as President and as Commander –in – Chief of the Armed Forces of the DemocraticSocialist Republic of Sri Lanka. I have awarded the honorary rank of Marshal of the Air Force to Air Chief MarshalWellarachchige Don Roshan Mahesh James Goonetileke (Rtd.), RWP & bar VSV USP PhD FIM (Sri Lanka) ndc pscCommander of the Sri Lanka Air Force (2006 – 2011) for outstanding gallantry, meritorious performance and distinguishedservice to the nation during the humanitarian operation and the defeat of terrorism in Sri Lanka given under my hand on05th day of August 2019.
MAITHRIPALA SIRISENA,President of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka.05th August, 2019
